comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
community.enter: Yuh reach {community} — big up di area!
dog.chase: Dawg a run yuh dung! Step pon it!
Watch di dawg deh, nuh! Him serious!
goat.hit: Lawd have mercy — yuh lick dung di goat!
Eeh? Yuh never see di goat inna di road?
Smaddy goat get lick! Dat ago cost yuh, brethren!
faithspen.approach: Faith's Pen coming up — nuff jerk chicken and roast yam deh wait pan yuh!
Smell dat? Faith's Pen ahead, brethren. Best jerk pon di island!
faithspen.eat: Ahh! Jerk chicken, roast yam, festival — Jamaican ting! Tyres fix up, spirit lift up!
Dat right deh — Faith's Pen nuh disappoint. Tyre good, belly full. Gwaan!
faithspen.skip: Yuh really drive past Faith's Pen widout stop? Yuh mad?
Next time, brethren. Nuh miss di jerk chicken again.
